call_purpose: You told us that leads were coming in from your form, but the autoresponder email was not going to them.

resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it.
You submitted a test lead from your page and confirmed the autoresponder email arrived in your inbox.

covered.text: We explained that you can verify your sender domain under email domain in settings, so that mails do not go to spam.

analysis_gaps.missing: A garbled support remark about an extension and an invoice could not be read reliably.

technical_details.text: Sender domain verification is under email domain in settings.
